thread:
alexp: Quick sync — kicking off Q3 Hosted API roadmap planning thread. We need to lock decisions on three linked items: embeddings latency SLO (customer-facing), rerank throughput objective for enterprise search, and chat fallback/rollout policy when dedicated capacity hits contention. Customers: Acme (needs sub-80ms embed for search relevance), FinCo (regulatory timeline for private deploy + rerank SLA), and two smaller PLG customers pushing streaming for chat.
mira: +1. We should separate hard SLO vs default SLO. Hard = what we guarantee on Dedicated, Default = hosted best-effort. Hard SLO has infra implications (reserved pools, pre-warmed engines).
sam-eng: For embedding sub-80ms we need to decide model-quantization mix and prefix caching. If we push quantized 4-bit for public we can hit it, but accuracy tradeoffs for rerank customers may be unacceptable.
jin-ml: We have evals showing 4-bit quant for text-sim-embedding has ~0.7% quality drop on FinCo's rerank set. We can include an optional "high-precision" flag that pins float16 models for rerank requests.
carla-cs: FinCo expects a formal commit by end of Q2 for their compliance window. If we can offer private deployment + pinned float16 rerank path with an SLA, they convert to Dedicated contract.
megan-sales: Important context: Acme is on trial and will expand if we ship the sub-80ms embedding SLA in hosted. Revenue bet: Acme ~ $15k/mo at scale. FinCo ~ enterprise $150k+/yr. Prioritize FinCo for sales, but Acme is a quick win.
alexp: Proposal (decisions needed):
1) Embedding SLOs: Default hosted P95 <= 120ms; Dedicated hard SLO P95 <= 80ms with reserved pre-warmed pools.
2) Rerank: Introduce a "high-precision rerank" route that uses float16 model variant, rate-limited for hosted, unlimited on Dedicated.
3) Chat fallbacks: Canary policy — route to smaller/cheaper variant when latency >SLO for 2 consecutive minutes, with automatic rollback if quality regressions >2% on eval set.
alexp: Draft launch criteria (need signoff):
```
- Perf: Dedicated P95 embedding <= 80ms under 90% load on reference benchmark
- Quality: Rerank precision drop <= 1% vs baseline for high-precision path
- Ops: Canary + rollback automation tested & documented
- Legal/Security: Private deployment checklist complete for FinCo (KMS, audit logs)
- Billing: pricing docs + quota behavior defined for high-precision route
```
mira: Technical notes: implementing reserved pools requires scheduler changes (burst-to-dedicated fallback), and we should expose a config flag per-tenant for "preferred_precision". Also need cost estimation for pre-warmed capacity.
sam-eng: Sizing ask: for Acme scale (1000 qps embed peak) pre-warmed pool cost ~= 12x of a single node if we keep cold start buffer. We can shave that with aggressive sharing and token-based admission, but it's more ops complexity.
jin-ml: Eval plan: run rerank A/B on FinCo dataset across float16 vs 4-bit quantized. Also add a small prompt-set regression harness for chat streaming fallback to catch hallucination regressions.
carla-cs: Can we commit to a timeline? FinCo compliance requires us to ship private deployment + rerank SLA by 2024-09-30.
alexp: Timeline proposal: Q3 scope split:
- Milestone A (by end of Q2): decision + design doc + cost estimate
- Milestone B (mid-Q3): implementation for high-precision rerank + reserved pool prototype
- Milestone C (end-Q3): closed beta with FinCo on private deployment
megan-sales: Sales flag: we can get a LOI from FinCo if we offer milestone-based commitment. Recommend we prioritize the private deploy path in the roadmap slice.
mira: Resource ask: need +0.5 SWE FTE on runtime and +0.3 infra SRE for 8 weeks to prototype reserved pools. Also product + security time for checklist.
alexp: Decision requested from eng leads & security by EOD Fri: accept the proposed SLOs & launch criteria, plus resource commits for prototype. If yes, I'll convert to PRD and OKR tasks.
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap doc review scheduled Thu 2pm. Add this thread to the agenda.
carla-cs: :thumbsup: from CS — I'll coordinate FinCo comms if we get signoff.
megan-sales: :rocket: We'll prep customer-facing commitment language.
jin-ml: On it for eval scaffolding.
mira: I'll confirm resource allocation by EOD Friday.
